sentences.text:
Mr.H.K.Muduli, Advocate
 Vs.
State of Odisha and another ..... Respondent

(for O.P.1)
 Coram:
 Justice Savitri Ratho
 Order

This appeal has been filed under Section 14 (A) of the S.C. and S.T. (POA) Act challenging the order dated 27.10.2022 passed by the learned 2nd Addl. Sessions Judge, Sambalpur in Special G.R.
Case No.79 of 2019 which arises out of Mahulpali P.S. Case No.165 of 2019, rejecting the prayer for bail of the appellant.
2.

Mr.H.K.Muduli, learned counsel for the appellant submits that the appellant has been falsely implicated in the case and he is in custody since more than 3 and 1/2 years (07.11.2019) and as trial is still in progress, he should be released on bail in view of his right to speedy trial.

3. Perusal of the order dated 27.10.2022 reveals that the appellant is facing trial for commission of offences under Sections 376 (2) //2//
(n)/376 (3) IPC, Section 6 of the POCSO Act and Section 3 (1) (2)/3 (2) (v) of S.C. and S.T. (POA)
Act and out of 23 charge sheeted witnesses, 10 witnesses have been examined and P.Ws.1 and 2 who are the mother and the victim have fully corroborated the allegation leveled against the accused.

4. Considering the fact that the appellant is in custody since more than three years, without going into the allegations available against him or issuing notice to the informant, the CRLA is disposed of directing the learned trial Court to dispose of the appeal expeditiously if possible by the end of Khirod Kumar Choudhury vs State Of Odisha And Another on 21 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/15704968/
1 December, 2023, if it is still pending.
